name: Chileno Bay Resort, Auberge Collection
positioning: Auberge Collection beach resort in Cabo San Lucas (officially Chileno Bay Resort & Residences), with rooms set around two infinity pools
best_for: Travelers who want beach activities such as snorkeling and paddle boarding
Families or groups wanting a villa with a kitchen and a private pool

facts.text: The resort's address is Carretera Transpeninsular San Jose-San Lucas Km. 15, Playa Chileno Bay, Cabo San Lucas.
The architecture uses sandstone brick and white stucco and blends into the desert setting.
Rooms are scattered around two infinity pools, and most look out over the Pacific.
The restaurant Comal serves modern takes on traditional Mexican dishes, spotlighting organic and local ingredients.
A taco bar on the beach offers a few different options each day.
Guests can borrow snorkeling equipment and paddle boards at the beach.
The three-bedroom oceanfront villa has a kitchen with a living room opening onto a patio with a small private pool overlooking the Pacific.
Condé Nast Traveler lists the resort in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2018 through 2026.
